q:
प्रतिष्ठित भारतीय साहित्यिक पुरस्कारों के संदर्भ में निम्नलिखित दो कथनों पर विचार कीजिए:
कथन I: ममता कालिया को उनकी कृति 'जीते जी इलाहाबाद' के लिए हिंदी का साहित्य अकादमी पुरस्कार 2025 प्रदान किया गया।
कथन II: प्रसिद्ध तमिल गीतकार एवं कवि आर. वैरामुत्तु को 60वें ज्ञानपीठ पुरस्कार के लिए चुना गया।
उपर्युक्त में से कौन-सा/से कथन सही है/हैं?
o: Both Statement I and Statement II
Neither Statement I nor Statement II
e:
Both statements are factually correct (दोनों कथन सत्य हैं): Mamta Kalia won the Sahitya Akademi Award 2025 in Hindi for 'Jeete Jee Allahabad', and R. Vairamuthu received the 60th Jnanpith Award.
Exam Booster Facts:
1. Sahitya Akademi Award is given annually in 24 languages (22 Eighth Schedule languages + English and Rajasthani).
2. Jnanpith Award is India's oldest and highest literary honour (instituted in 1961; first awarded to G. Sankara Kurup in 1965 for Malayalam).
3. Sumitranandan Pant was the first Hindi writer to win the Jnanpith Award (1968, for 'Chidambara').
qe:
Consider the following two statements regarding prestigious Indian literary awards:
Statement I: Mamta Kalia was honoured with the Sahitya Akademi Award 2025 in Hindi for her work 'Jeete Jee Allahabad'.
Statement II: Noted Tamil lyricist and poet R. Vairamuthu was selected for the 60th Jnanpith Award.
Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
oe: Both Statement I and Statement II
Neither Statement I nor Statement II

q: अक्टूबर 2026 में, किस भारतीय बायोटेक स्टार्टअप ने AI-आधारित औषधि खोज (AI-Based Drug Discovery) को आगे बढ़ाने के लिए ₹86 करोड़ का वित्तीय सहयोग प्राप्त किया?
e:
Peptris secured ₹86 crore support in October 2026 to accelerate AI-based drug discovery (अक्टूबर 2026 में पेप्ट्रिस को AI-आधारित औषधि खोज के लिए ₹86 करोड़ का सहयोग मिला)।
Exam Booster Facts:
1. AI in drug discovery drastically reduces the time and cost of molecular screening and target validation.
2. Biotechnology Industry Research Assistance Council (BIRAC) under DBT promotes Indian biotech startups.
3. India is globally known as the 'Pharmacy of the World', supplying a major share of generic medicines and vaccines.
qe: In October 2026, which Indian biotech startup secured ₹86 crore in financial support for advancing AI-Based Drug Discovery?

q: अक्टूबर 2026 में, ICAR–भारतीय कृषि जैव प्रौद्योगिकी संस्थान (ICAR-IIAB) की नई अनुसंधान सुविधाओं का उद्घाटन किस शहर में किया गया?
e:
New facilities of ICAR–Indian Institute of Agricultural Biotechnology (ICAR-IIAB) were inaugurated in Ranchi, Jharkhand in October 2026 (ICAR-IIAB राँची में स्थित है)।
Exam Booster Facts:
1. ICAR (Indian Council of Agricultural Research) was established on 16 July 1929 and is headquartered in New Delhi.
2. ICAR-IIAB focuses on genomics, molecular breeding, and agricultural biotechnology to boost crop resilience.
3. National Institute of Secondary Agriculture (formerly IINRG) is also located in Ranchi.
qe: In October 2026, new research facilities of the ICAR–Indian Institute of Agricultural Biotechnology (ICAR-IIAB) were inaugurated in which city?

q:
भारत के मत्स्य पालन और निर्यात निकायों (नवंबर 2026 में चर्चित) के संदर्भ में निम्नलिखित कथनों पर विचार कीजिए:
कथन I: भारत विश्व का दूसरा सबसे बड़ा मछली और जलीय कृषि (aquaculture) उत्पादक देश है।
कथन II: MPEDA समुद्री उत्पादों के निर्यात को बढ़ावा देता है, जबकि APEDA कृषि एवं प्रसंस्कृत खाद्य उत्पादों को बढ़ावा देता है।
उपर्युक्त में से कौन-सा/से कथन सही है/हैं?
o: Both Statement I and Statement II
Neither Statement I nor Statement II
e:
Both statements are correct (दोनों कथन सही हैं): India ranks 2nd globally in fish and aquaculture production (after China), MPEDA (headquartered in Kochi) handles marine exports, and APEDA (headquartered in New Delhi) handles agricultural and processed food exports.
Exam Booster Facts:
1. Both APEDA and MPEDA function under the Ministry of Commerce and Industry.
2. Pradhan Mantri Matsya Sampada Yojana (PMMSY) was launched in 2020 to drive the 'Blue Revolution' in India.
3. National Fish Farmers Day is observed on 10 July every year.
qe:
With reference to India's fisheries and export bodies (cited in November 2026), consider the following statements:
Statement I: India is the world's second-largest fish and aquaculture producer.
Statement II: MPEDA promotes the export of marine products, whereas APEDA promotes agricultural and processed food products.
Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
oe: Both Statement I and Statement II
Neither Statement I nor Statement II

q: अक्टूबर 2026 में, भारतीय नौसेना के लिए किस सुपरसोनिक क्रूज मिसाइल प्रणाली को सुदृढ़ करने हेतु ₹661.50 करोड़ का अनुबंध हस्ताक्षरित किया गया?
e:
A ₹661.50 crore contract was signed in October 2026 for the Indian Navy's BrahMos supersonic cruise missile system (भारतीय नौसेना की ब्रह्मोस प्रणाली के लिए ₹661.50 करोड़ का अनुबंध हुआ)।
Exam Booster Facts:
1. BrahMos is a joint venture between India's DRDO and Russia's NPO Mashinostroyeniya, named after the Brahmaputra and Moskva rivers.
2. BrahMos is a ramjet-powered supersonic cruise missile capable of launch from land, sea, submarine, and air platforms.
3. India also opened a BrahMos manufacturing unit in Lucknow (UP Defence Industrial Corridor).
qe: In October 2026, a contract worth ₹661.50 crore was signed to strengthen which supersonic cruise missile system for the Indian Navy?

q: अक्टूबर 2026 में, किस केंद्र शासित प्रदेश में सर्वे ऑफ इंडिया के मानचित्र पर 28 स्थान चिह्नित किए गए तथा ₹3,350 करोड़ की 5 परियोजनाओं का उद्घाटन किया गया?
e:
In October 2026, 28 locations in Ladakh were officially marked on the Survey of India map and 5 projects worth ₹3,350 crore were inaugurated there (लद्दाख में 28 स्थान चिह्नित किए गए तथा ₹3,350 करोड़ की 5 परियोजनाओं का उद्घाटन हुआ)।
Exam Booster Facts:
1. Survey of India (established in 1767) is India's national mapping agency, headquartered in Dehradun, Uttarakhand.
2. Ladakh became a separate Union Territory without a legislature on 31 October 2019 (comprising Leh and Kargil districts).
3. Hemis National Park in Ladakh is India's largest National Park and is famous for snow leopards.
qe: In October 2026, 28 strategic locations were officially marked on the Survey of India map and 5 infrastructure projects worth ₹3,350 crore were inaugurated in which Union Territory?

q: अपने ऐतिहासिक वस्त्र उद्योग के कारण उत्तर प्रदेश का कौन-सा शहर 'उत्तर भारत का मैनचेस्टर' के नाम से प्रसिद्ध है?
e:
Kanpur is called the 'Manchester of North India' (कानपुर को उत्तर भारत का मैनचेस्टर कहा जाता है)।
Exam Booster Facts:
1. Ahmedabad is known as the 'Manchester of India', and Coimbatore as the 'Manchester of South India'.
2. Kanpur also hosts IIT Kanpur, National Sugar Institute, and Indian Institute of Pulses Research.
3. UP's largest industrial city is Kanpur, situated on the right bank of the Ganga river.
qe: Which city of Uttar Pradesh is famously known as the 'Manchester of North India' due to its historic textile industry?

q: प्रसिद्ध बौद्ध तीर्थ स्थल 'सारनाथ', जहाँ गौतम बुद्ध ने अपना प्रथम उपदेश (धर्मचक्रप्रवर्तन) दिया था, उत्तर प्रदेश के किस शहर के निकट स्थित है?
e:
Sarnath (ancient Rishipatana / Mrigadava) is located about 10 km northeast of Varanasi (सारनाथ वाराणसी के निकट स्थित है)।
Exam Booster Facts:
1. The Lion Capital of Ashoka at Sarnath was adopted as the National Emblem of India on 26 January 1950.
2. Dhamek Stupa and Chaukhandi Stupa are major monuments at Sarnath.
3. Gautam Buddha attained Mahaparinirvana at Kushinagar (UP) and spent the most rainy seasons (Vassavasa) at Shravasti (UP).
qe: The famous Buddhist pilgrimage site 'Sarnath', where Gautam Buddha delivered his first sermon (Dhammachakkappavattana), is located near which city of Uttar Pradesh?

q: उत्तर प्रदेश की निम्नलिखित में से कौन-सी नदी पीलीभीत जिले की फुलहर झील (गोमत ताल) से निकलती है?
e:
The Gomti river is a plains-origin river rising from Fulhar Lake (Gomat Taal) near Madhotanda in Pilibhit district, UP, and joins the Ganga at Kaithi near Ghazipur (गोमती नदी पीलीभीत की फुलहर झील से निकलती है)।
Exam Booster Facts:
1. Lucknow, Sultanpur, and Jaunpur are major UP cities located on the banks of the Gomti river.
2. Betwa and Ken are right-bank tributaries of the Yamuna originating in Madhya Pradesh.
3. Gorakhpur is situated on the banks of the Rapti river.
qe: Which of the following Uttar Pradesh rivers originates from Fulhar Lake (Gomat Taal) in Pilibhit district?

q: भारतीय संसद में उत्तर प्रदेश को क्रमशः लोकसभा और राज्यसभा की कितनी सीटें आवंटित हैं?
e:
Uttar Pradesh sends the highest number of parliamentarians to both Houses: 80 seats in the Lok Sabha and 31 seats in the Rajya Sabha (उत्तर प्रदेश में लोकसभा की 80 और राज्यसभा की 31 सीटें हैं)।
Exam Booster Facts:
1. Uttar Pradesh has a bicameral state legislature with 403 seats in the Vidhan Sabha (Legislative Assembly) and 100 seats in the Vidhan Parishad (Legislative Council).
2. Uttar Pradesh currently has 75 districts grouped into 18 administrative divisions (मण्डल).
3. Allahabad (Prayagraj) High Court has the largest sanctioned judicial strength in India.
qe: How many Lok Sabha and Rajya Sabha seats are allocated to Uttar Pradesh in the Indian Parliament respectively?

q: भारतीय चित्रकला, मूर्तिकला और हिंदी साहित्यिक पांडुलिपियों के संग्रह के लिए प्रसिद्ध 'भारत कला भवन' संग्रहालय कहाँ स्थित है?
e:
Bharat Kala Bhavan is located on the Banaras Hindu University (BHU) campus in Varanasi; it was founded in 1920 by Rai Krishnadasa (भारत कला भवन वाराणसी में BHU परिसर में स्थित है)।
Exam Booster Facts:
1. Bharat Mata Mandir (housing a relief marble map of undivided India) is also located in Varanasi.
2. State Museum Lucknow (1863) is the oldest museum in Uttar Pradesh.
3. Allahabad Museum (Prayagraj) preserves Chandra Shekhar Azad's pistol and manuscripts of Sumitranandan Pant and Mahadevi Verma.
qe: Where is the 'Bharat Kala Bhavan' museum, renowned for its collection of Indian paintings, sculptures, and Hindi literary manuscripts, located?

q: 1828 में कलकत्ता में 'ब्रह्म समाज' की स्थापना निम्नलिखित में से किसने की थी?
e:
Raja Ram Mohan Roy founded the Brahmo Sabha (later Brahmo Samaj) in August 1828 to promote monotheism and social reform, including abolition of Sati (1829) (ब्रह्म समाज की स्थापना 1828 में राजा राममोहन राय ने की)।
Exam Booster Facts:
1. Swami Dayananda Saraswati founded Arya Samaj in 1875 in Bombay ('Go back to the Vedas', authored 'Satyarth Prakash' in Hindi).
2. Swami Vivekananda founded Ramakrishna Mission in 1897.
3. Raja Ram Mohan Roy also published 'Samvad Kaumudi' (Bengali) and 'Mirat-ul-Akbar' (Persian).
qe: Who among the following founded the 'Brahmo Samaj' in 1828 in Calcutta?

q: भारतीय भाषाओं के समाचार पत्रों पर प्रतिबंध लगाने वाले वर्नाक्यूलर प्रेस एक्ट (1878) को पारित करने से भारत का कौन-सा वायसराय संबंधित था?
e:
Lord Lytton enacted the Vernacular Press Act in 1878 (nicknamed the 'Gagging Act'); it was later repealed by Lord Ripon in 1882 (वर्नाक्यूलर प्रेस एक्ट 1878 लॉर्ड लिटन ने लागू किया और लॉर्ड रिपन ने 1882 में निरस्त किया)।
Exam Booster Facts:
1. Amrita Bazar Patrika famously converted overnight from a Bengali-English bilingual paper into a purely English newspaper to escape the Act.
2. Lord Ripon is known as the 'Father of Local Self-Government in India' (1882 Resolution).
3. Lord Curzon partitioned Bengal in 1905.
qe: Which Viceroy of India was associated with the passing of the Vernacular Press Act (1878) to curb Indian-language newspapers?

q: प्रसिद्ध नारा 'स्वराज मेरा जन्मसिद्ध अधिकार है और मैं इसे लेकर रहूँगा' किसने दिया था?
e:
Lokmanya Bal Gangadhar Tilak gave this iconic slogan during the Home Rule Movement (1916) (यह प्रसिद्ध नारा बाल गंगाधर तिलक ने दिया था)।
Exam Booster Facts:
1. Tilak started two newspapers: 'Kesari' (Marathi) and 'Mahratta' (English), and authored 'Gita Rahasya' in Mandalay Jail.
2. Tilak popularized Ganapati Festival (1893) and Shivaji Festival (1895) to foster national unity.
3. Valentine Chirol called Tilak the 'Father of Indian Unrest'.
qe: The famous slogan 'Swaraj is my birthright and I shall have it' (स्वराज मेरा जन्मसिद्ध अधिकार है और मैं इसे लेकर रहूँगा) was given by:

q:
सूची-I (भक्ति संत/आचार्य) को सूची-II (दार्शनिक सिद्धांत) से सुमेलित कीजिए तथा सही कूट चुनिए:
सूची-I:
1. आदि शंकराचार्य
2. रामानुजाचार्य
3. माधवाचार्य
4. वल्लभाचार्य
सूची-II:
(a) शुद्धाद्वैत
(b) द्वैत
(c) विशिष्टाद्वैत
(d) अद्वैत
e:
Shankaracharya propounded Advaita, Ramanujacharya Vishishtadvaita, Madhvacharya Dvaita, and Vallabhacharya Shuddhadvaita / Pushtimarg (1-d, 2-c, 3-b, 4-a)।
Exam Booster Facts:
1. Nimbarkacharya propounded Dvaitadvaita (द्वैताद्वैत / भेदाभेद).
2. Vallabhacharya's son Vitthalnath founded the 'Ashtachhap' (अष्टछाप, 1565) of Krishna-bhakti poets including Surdas.
3. This question bridges Indian History and Hindi Bhakti-kaal literature!
qe:
Match List-I (Bhakti Saint) with List-II (Philosophical Doctrine) and select the correct code:
List-I:
1. Adi Shankaracharya
2. Ramanujacharya
3. Madhvacharya
4. Vallabhacharya
List-II:
(a) Shuddhadvaita (शुद्धाद्वैत)
(b) Dvaita (द्वैत)
(c) Vishishtadvaita (विशिष्टाद्वैत)
(d) Advaita (अद्वैत)

q: अखिल भारतीय कांग्रेस समिति द्वारा 8 अगस्त 1942 को 'भारत छोड़ो प्रस्ताव' किस स्थान पर पारित किया गया था?
e:
On 8 August 1942, the Quit India Resolution was ratified at Gowalia Tank Maidan (now August Kranti Maidan) in Bombay, where Mahatma Gandhi gave the call 'Do or Die' (करो या मरो) (भारत छोड़ो प्रस्ताव बंबई के ग्वालिया टैंक मैदान में पारित हुआ)।
Exam Booster Facts:
1. Aruna Asaf Ali hoisted the tricolour at Gowalia Tank Maidan on 9 August 1942 and is known as the 'Heroine of 1942'.
2. Parallel governments (प्रतिसरकार) were set up in Ballia (UP, under Chittu Pandey), Tamluk (Bengal), and Satara (Maharashtra).
3. The movement followed the failure of the Cripps Mission (March 1942).
qe: The Quit India Resolution was passed by the All India Congress Committee on 8 August 1942 at which venue?

q: भारतीय संविधान का कौन-सा अनुच्छेद देवनागरी लिपि में हिंदी को संघ की राजभाषा घोषित करता है?
e:
Article 343(1) in Part XVII of the Constitution states that the official language of the Union shall be Hindi in Devanagari script (अनुच्छेद 343(1) संघ की राजभाषा देवनागरी लिपि में हिंदी निर्धारित करता है)।
Exam Booster Facts:
1. Hindi Diwas is celebrated on 14 September because the Constituent Assembly adopted Hindi as the official language on 14 September 1949.
2. Article 351 directs the Union to promote the spread and development of the Hindi language.
3. The Eighth Schedule originally listed 14 languages and currently contains 22 recognized languages.
qe: Which Article of the Indian Constitution declares Hindi in Devanagari script as the Official Language of the Union?

q: शिक्षा का अधिकार (RTE) अधिनियम, 2009 के अंतर्गत निजी गैर-सहायता प्राप्त गैर-अल्पसंख्यक विद्यालयों की प्रवेश कक्षाओं में कमजोर वर्गों और वंचित समूहों के बच्चों के लिए कितने प्रतिशत सीटें आरक्षित होनी चाहिए?
e:
Section 12(1)(c) of the RTE Act, 2009 mandates 25% reservation for Economically Weaker Sections (EWS) and Disadvantaged Groups (DG) in entry-level classes (RTE अधिनियम की धारा 12(1)(c) के तहत 25% आरक्षण अनिवार्य है)।
Exam Booster Facts:
1. RTE Act, 2009 bans capitation fees, screening procedures, corporal punishment, and private tuition by government school teachers.
2. Prescribed Pupil-Teacher Ratio (PTR) at primary level (Classes 1–5) is 30 : 1, and at upper primary level (Classes 6–8) is 35 : 1.
3. Minimum working days per academic year: 200 days (primary) and 220 days (upper primary).
qe: Under the Right to Education (RTE) Act, 2009, what percentage of seats in entry-level classes of private unaided non-minority schools must be reserved for children from weaker sections and disadvantaged groups?

q: किस संविधान संशोधन द्वारा बोडो, डोगरी, मैथिली और संथाली भाषाओं को भारतीय संविधान की आठवीं अनुसूची में जोड़ा गया?
e:
The 92nd Constitutional Amendment Act, 2003 added Bodo, Dogri, Maithili, and Santhali (BDMS), raising the Eighth Schedule total from 18 to 22 languages (92वें संशोधन 2003 द्वारा बोडो, डोगरी, मैथिली और संथाली जोड़ी गईं)।
Exam Booster Facts:
1. 21st Amendment (1967) added Sindhi (15th language).
2. 71st Amendment (1992) added Konkani, Manipuri, and Nepali (16th–18th languages).
3. 96th Amendment (2011) changed the spelling of 'Oriya' to 'Odia'.
qe: Which Constitutional Amendment added Bodo, Dogri, Maithili, and Santhali to the Eighth Schedule of the Indian Constitution?

q: स्कूली शिक्षा नीतियों और पाठ्यक्रम पर केंद्र व राज्य सरकारों को सलाह देने के लिए भारत सरकार द्वारा 1961 में किस स्वायत्त संगठन की स्थापना की गई थी?
e:
NCERT (National Council of Educational Research and Training) was established on 1 September 1961 in New Delhi (NCERT की स्थापना 1961 में हुई थी)।
Exam Booster Facts:
1. UGC (University Grants Commission) became a statutory body in 1956 (under UGC Act, 1956).
2. NCTE (National Council for Teacher Education) attained statutory status in 1995 (under NCTE Act, 1993) to regulate teacher education (B.Ed., D.El.Ed.).
3. AICTE (All India Council for Technical Education) gained statutory status in 1987.
qe: Which body was established by the Government of India in 1961 as an autonomous organization to advise Central and State Governments on school education policies and curriculum?

q: भारतीय संविधान के अंतर्गत राज्यसभा का पदेन सभापति कौन होता है?
e:
Under Article 64 and Article 89(1), the Vice-President of India is the ex-officio Chairman of the Rajya Sabha (अनुच्छेद 64 के अनुसार उपराष्ट्रपति राज्यसभा के पदेन सभापति होते हैं)।
Exam Booster Facts:
1. The Vice-President is elected by an electoral college consisting of all members (elected + nominated) of both Houses of Parliament.
2. Rajya Sabha is a permanent house (cannot be dissolved); one-third of its members retire every two years (Article 83).
3. Maximum strength of Rajya Sabha is 250 (238 states/UTs + 12 nominated by the President for literature, science, art, and social service).
qe: Who is the ex-officio Chairman of the Rajya Sabha (Council of States) under the Constitution of India?

q: दक्कन ट्रैप के बेसाल्ट लावा के अपक्षय से निर्मित कौन-सी मृदा भारत में कपास की खेती के लिए सर्वाधिक उपयुक्त है?
e:
Black soil (Regur / Black Cotton Soil) is rich in clay, lime, iron, and magnesium, and retains moisture exceptionally well ('self-ploughing' soil) (काली या रेगुर मिट्टी कपास के लिए सर्वश्रेष्ठ है)।
Exam Booster Facts:
1. Alluvial soil (जलोढ़ मृदा) covers the largest area (~40%) of India, especially the Indo-Gangetic plain of Uttar Pradesh, Bihar, and Punjab.
2. Old alluvium is called Bhangar (बांगर) and new fertile flood-plain alluvium is called Khadar (खादर).
3. Laterite soil is ideal for cashew nut, tea, and coffee cultivation.
qe: Which soil type, formed from the weathering of Deccan Trap basaltic lava, is most suitable for cotton cultivation in India?

q: जनगणना 2011 के अनुसार, भारत के किस राज्य की कुल जनसंख्या में शहरी जनसंख्या का प्रतिशत सर्वाधिक था?
e:
Among Indian states, Goa recorded the highest urbanization rate (62.17%), followed by Mizoram (52.11%) and Tamil Nadu (48.45%) (राज्यों में गोवा में शहरी जनसंख्या का प्रतिशत सर्वाधिक 62.17% था)।
Exam Booster Facts:
1. In absolute numbers, Maharashtra had the largest urban population, followed by Uttar Pradesh.
2. India's overall urbanization rate in Census 2011 was 31.16% (rural: 68.84%); UP's urbanization rate was 22.27%.
3. Himachal Pradesh had the highest percentage of rural population (~89.97%).
qe: According to Census 2011, which state of India had the highest percentage of its population living in urban areas (highest urbanization rate among states)?

q: भारत के निम्नलिखित बायोस्फीयर रिजर्वों में से कौन-सा यूनेस्को के विश्व बायोस्फीयर रिजर्व नेटवर्क (WNBR) में शामिल नहीं है?
e:
Out of India's 18 Biosphere Reserves, 12 are in UNESCO's WNBR (Nilgiri was the first in 2000; Panna was the 12th in 2020). Manas (Assam) is a UNESCO World Heritage Site, NOT in UNESCO's WNBR (मानस बायोस्फीयर रिजर्व यूनेस्को के WNBR में शामिल नहीं है)।
Exam Booster Facts:
1. Nilgiri Biosphere Reserve (1986) was India's first Biosphere Reserve, spanning Tamil Nadu, Kerala, and Karnataka.
2. Nanda Devi (Uttarakhand) and Sundarbans (West Bengal) are both UNESCO World Heritage Sites and WNBR sites.
3. Cold Desert (Himachal Pradesh), Dihang-Dibang, Dibru-Saikhowa, Kachchh, Seshachalam, and Manas are the 6 Indian BRs not in WNBR.
qe: Which of the following Biosphere Reserves of India is NOT included in UNESCO's World Network of Biosphere Reserves (WNBR)?

q: नीति आयोग (NITI Aayog) ने भारत के योजना आयोग का स्थान किस तिथि को लिया था?
e:
NITI Aayog (National Institution for Transforming India) was established on 1 January 2015 as a non-constitutional, non-statutory executive policy think tank (नीति आयोग की स्थापना 1 जनवरी 2015 को हुई थी)।
Exam Booster Facts:
1. The Prime Minister of India is the ex-officio Chairperson of NITI Aayog.
2. Its Governing Council includes all State Chief Ministers and Lt. Governors of Union Territories (promoting cooperative federalism).
3. The Planning Commission had been established on 15 March 1950; the 12th Five-Year Plan (2012–17) was the last Five-Year Plan.
qe: NITI Aayog replaced the Planning Commission of India on which date?

q: अर्थशास्त्र में 'लॉरेंज वक्र' और 'गिनी गुणांक' का उपयोग किसे मापने के लिए किया जाता है?
e:
The Lorenz Curve graphically depicts income/wealth distribution, and the Gini Coefficient (ranging from 0 = perfect equality to 1 = perfect inequality) quantifies inequality (लॉरेंज वक्र और गिनी गुणांक आय की असमानता मापते हैं)।
Exam Booster Facts:
1. Phillips Curve shows the inverse relationship between inflation and unemployment in the short run.
2. Laffer Curve shows the relationship between tax rates and tax revenue.
3. Engel's Law states that as household income rises, the proportion of income spent on food decreases.
qe: In economics, the 'Lorenz Curve' and the 'Gini Coefficient' are used to measure:

q: किस समिति ने पुरानी गरीबी आकलन पद्धति के स्थान पर स्वास्थ्य और शिक्षा के व्यय को शामिल करने वाली नई पद्धति की सिफारिश (2009 की रिपोर्ट) की थी?
e:
The Suresh Tendulkar Committee (2009) shifted away from purely calorie-based poverty lines to a mixed reference period incorporating health and education expenses (सुरेश तेंदुलकर समिति ने स्वास्थ्य व शिक्षा व्यय को गरीबी आकलन में शामिल किया)।
Exam Booster Facts:
1. C. Rangarajan Committee (2014) later revised poverty estimates upward.
2. Currently, NITI Aayog publishes India's National Multidimensional Poverty Index (MPI) based on 3 dimensions: Health, Education, and Standard of Living (12 indicators).
3. Narasimham Committee dealt with banking reforms; Urjit Patel Committee recommended CPI inflation targeting and the MPC.
qe: Which committee recommended the replacement of the old poverty estimation methodology with a new basket including expenditure on health and education (2009 report)?

q: मानव शरीर में चोट के स्थान पर रक्त का थक्का जमाने के लिए मुख्य रूप से कौन-सी रक्त कोशिकाएँ उत्तरदायी होती हैं?
e:
Platelets (Thrombocytes) release thromboplastin at injury sites, initiating the clotting cascade (Fibrinogen → Fibrin mesh) with Ca²⁺ and Vitamin K (प्लेटलेट्स रक्त का थक्का जमाने में प्रमुख भूमिका निभाते हैं)।
Exam Booster Facts:
1. Normal platelet count in healthy humans is 1.5 to 4.5 lakh per microlitre of blood; platelet count drops sharply in Dengue fever.
2. RBCs (Erythrocytes) transport oxygen via haemoglobin (lifespan ~120 days; destroyed in spleen — 'graveyard of RBCs').
3. WBCs (Leucocytes) defend against pathogens ('soldiers of the body').
qe: Which blood cells in the human body are primarily responsible for blood clotting at the site of an injury?

q: निम्नलिखित में से कौन-सा एक ओपन-सोर्स लर्निंग मैनेजमेंट सिस्टम (LMS) है जिसका उपयोग विश्व भर के विद्यालयों और विश्वविद्यालयों द्वारा ऑनलाइन पाठ्यक्रमों और मूल्यांकन के लिए किया जाता है?
e:
Moodle (Modular Object-Oriented Dynamic Learning Environment) is a popular free, open-source LMS used globally in EdTech and e-learning (मूडल एक प्रसिद्ध ओपन-सोर्स LMS है)।
Exam Booster Facts:
1. Other widely used LMS platforms include Google Classroom, Canvas, and Blackboard.
2. India's 'e-Pathshala' (by NCERT/MoE) provides free digital textbooks and e-resources for students and teachers.
3. 'PARAKH' (Performance Assessment, Review, and Analysis of Knowledge for Holistic Development) is the national assessment centre under NEP 2020.
qe: Which of the following is an open-source Learning Management System (LMS) widely used by schools and universities globally for online courses and assessments?

q: विद्युत प्रतिरोध का SI मात्रक क्या है, और तापमान बढ़ने पर किसी शुद्ध धात्विक चालक का प्रतिरोध सामान्यतः कैसे परिवर्तित होता है?
o: Ohm; decreases with increase in temperature
Volt; increases with increase in temperature
Ohm; increases with increase in temperature
e:
The SI unit of resistance is the Ohm (Ω). In pure metallic conductors, rising temperature increases lattice vibrations (more electron collisions), so resistance INCREASES (शुद्ध धातुओं में तापमान बढ़ने पर प्रतिरोध बढ़ता है)।
Exam Booster Facts:
1. In semiconductors (Silicon, Germanium), resistance DECREASES with rising temperature because more charge carriers are freed.
2. Resistance R = ρ(L/A), where ρ is resistivity (unit: Ohm-metre, Ω·m).
3. Superconductors exhibit zero electrical resistance below their critical temperature.
qe: What is the SI unit of electrical resistance, and how does the resistance of a pure metallic conductor generally change with an increase in temperature?
oe: Ohm; decreases with increase in temperature
Volt; increases with increase in temperature
Ohm; increases with increase in temperature
